body:
This PR resolves #6001 by properly restoring closure fields from checkpoints when the `model.closure` is a tuple.

Previously, `tuple(generator)` was building a 1-tuple containing the generator and never iterates it, so nothing was ever restored. Now we restore each element in place with a loop, similar to the `NamedTuple` method.
title: Restore closure fields from checkpoints when `closure` is a tuple
